tickets.title: Add cpal as an optional dependency behind the cpal-input feature and implement device-backed capture returning Result<Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource>, SipError> with an integration test

contracts.precondition: cpal is an optional dependency reachable only through the `cpal-input` feature (default build graph contains no cpal). The RFC §40 signature exists behind #[cfg(feature = "cpal-input")]: `pub async fn open_default_microphone_source(format: AudioFormat) -> Result<Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource>, SipError>`. The input `format` is a validated AudioFormat (AudioFormat::new succeeded; sample_rate ∈ {Hz8000, Hz16000, Hz24000, Hz48000}, bit_depth ∈ {I16, F32}, channel_layout ∈ {Mono, StereoInOut}, frame_ms ∈ {10, 20, 40, 60}).
contracts.postcondition: When a default input device exists and its native sample format is convertible to the i16 pipeline contract, open_default_microphone_source returns Ok(Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>) whose next_chunk fills the caller's &mut [i16] buffer with captured PCM and returns the written sample count. Device-open, format-mismatch, build-stream, and play failures surface as Err(SipError) (SipErrorKind::NativeError for device/stream errors; SipErrorKind::AudioFormatUnsupported for non-convertible sample formats) — never a panic.
contracts.invariant: The returned source is AsyncAudioSource + Send and can be stored as Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send> in AudioMixer (ErasedAudioSource auto-derived via blanket impl). Sample conversion clamps into the valid i16 range (no wraparound). With `cpal-input` disabled, the function, the CpalMicrophoneSource type, and the cpal crate are compiled out of the build.

contracts.precondition: Audio subscribe uses sources — AudioMixer stores Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>; AsyncAudioSource trait is defined as #[async_trait::async_trait] pub trait AsyncAudioSource: Send { async fn next_chunk(&mut self, buf: &mut [i16]) -> usize; }.
contracts.postcondition: ErasedAudioSource blanket impl auto-derived for all T: AsyncAudioSource + Send; SyncAudioSource trait and SyncSourceAdapter<T: SyncAudioSource + Send> provided for synchronous sources; any new concrete source (e.g. CpalMicrophoneSource) implementing AsyncAudioSource + Send automatically gains ErasedAudioSource.
contracts.invariant: ErasedAudioSource auto-derived for every AsyncAudioSource implementor — blanket impl <T: AsyncAudioSource + Send> ErasedAudioSource for T must compile. SyncSourceAdapter<T: SyncAudioSource + Send> must implement AsyncAudioSource + Send. CpalMicrophoneSource must implement AsyncAudioSource + Send so it is usable as Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>.

### Goal
Replace the P8-4 placeholder body of `open_default_microphone_source` (src/api/asyncaudiosrc_adapter.rs:167-176) with real cpal device capture by adding cpal as an optional dependency behind the `cpal-input` feature, so the RFC §40 API returns `Result<Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource>, SipError>` backed by the platform default microphone, plus a feature-gated integration test.

### Purpose
The `cpal-input` feature has been declared empty (Cargo.toml:27) since P1-3, and the microphone source is the only RFC-required audio source that is not device-backed. Downstream consumers (AudioMixer via P5-2, the audio_tap example via P8-6, AI TTS source insertion) rely on opening the default microphone as an AsyncAudioSource; without this ticket the function is a stub that always returns a typed error.

### Motivation
P8-4 delivered the AsyncAudioSource adapter machinery (ErasedAudioSource/SyncAudioSource/SyncSourceAdapter) under a no-new-dependencies constraint, deferring the cpal dependency and leaving the `[::STUB::] P8-7` marker. This ticket removes that deferral: the adapter types are stable, the feature gate exists, and the remaining work is wiring cpal in and resolving the marker.

### Constraints
- cpal must be an optional dependency reachable only via `cpal-input`; default builds must not pull the cpal crate (feature-additive invariant). Cargo.toml:40 already declares `check-cfg = ['cfg(feature, values("cpal-input"))']`.
- MSRV is 1.95; pin a cpal version whose API is stable and documented. cpal 0.15/0.16/0.18 differ — v0.18 requires an explicit `stream.play()` after build and pins the sample rate/config explicitly.
- The public `open_default_microphone_source` signature must not change (C051 precondition); the returned source must implement AsyncAudioSource + Send.
- No panics on device failure — all errors map to SipError (NativeError for device/stream, AudioFormatUnsupported for non-convertible sample formats).
- CI without audio hardware must not run the device integration test by default (#[ignore]).

tickets.invariants:
- 【Normal condition】With `cpal-input` enabled and a default input device present, open_default_microphone_source returns Ok(Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>) and next_chunk fills the i16 buffer with device PCM. The cpal crate compiles only under the feature (Cargo.toml: cpal-input = ["dep:cpal"]).
- 【Invariant on error】Device-open, default-config, build-stream, and play failures never panic — they surface as Err(SipError). Sample formats outside the convertible set {I16, F32, U16} map to SipErrorKind::AudioFormatUnsupported; other device errors map to SipErrorKind::NativeError.
- 【Internal state invariant】CpalMicrophoneSource holds a cpal::Stream plus an Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<i16>>> sample queue; the queue grows only from the cpal callback thread and shrinks only via next_chunk; next_chunk returns 0 when the queue is empty (end-of-stream).
- 【Boundary invariant】Sample conversion is bijective at the extremes and clamped in between: u16::MAX↔i16::MAX, 0↔i16::MIN, 0x8000↔0; f32 in [-1.0, 1.0] maps linearly with clamping. A zero-length buffer returns 0 without panicking; a 65536-sample buffer (AudioMixer boundary) drains without overflow.
tickets.instrumentation:
- 【Logging】On open_default_microphone_source success, log the resolved device name and sample format at tracing::debug (device name via cpal Device::name()); on failure log the returned SipError at tracing::warn including the requested AudioFormat.
- 【Metrics】No new counters in this ticket; the existing metrics feature is untouched. The capture path is device-driven and not a hot counter; frames-per-second metrics for the audio pipeline are deferred to the audio_pipeline tickets.
- 【Error tracking】Every device failure path maps to a distinct, greppable SipError message prefix: no_default_input_device / default_input_config_failed / unsupported_sample_format / build_stream_failed / play_failed. All errors use SipErrorKind::NativeError (device/stream) or SipErrorKind::AudioFormatUnsupported (sample format) and are returned — never swallowed or converted to a panic.
- 【Health check】The source exposes no explicit health method; liveness is inferred from next_chunk returning > 0 samples. A failing stream surfaces via the cpal error callback, which converts the error to SipError and logs at tracing::error (no unwind across the callback boundary).

contracts.precondition: cpal is an optional dependency reachable only through the `cpal-input` feature (default build graph contains no cpal). The RFC §40 signature exists behind #[cfg(feature = "cpal-input")]: `pub async fn open_default_microphone_source(format: AudioFormat) -> Result<Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource>, SipError>`. The input `format` is a validated AudioFormat (AudioFormat::new succeeded; sample_rate ∈ {Hz8000, Hz16000, Hz24000, Hz48000}, bit_depth ∈ {I16, F32}, channel_layout ∈ {Mono, StereoInOut}, frame_ms ∈ {10, 20, 40, 60}).
contracts.postcondition: When a default input device exists and its native sample format is convertible to the i16 pipeline contract, open_default_microphone_source returns Ok(Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>) whose next_chunk fills the caller's &mut [i16] buffer with captured PCM and returns the written sample count. Device-open, format-mismatch, build-stream, and play failures surface as Err(SipError) (SipErrorKind::NativeError for device/stream errors; SipErrorKind::AudioFormatUnsupported for non-convertible sample formats) — never a panic.
contracts.invariant: The returned source is AsyncAudioSource + Send and can be stored as Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send> in AudioMixer (ErasedAudioSource auto-derived via blanket impl). Sample conversion clamps into the valid i16 range (no wraparound). With `cpal-input` disabled, the function, the CpalMicrophoneSource type, and the cpal crate are compiled out of the build.

contracts.precondition: Audio subscribe uses sources — AudioMixer stores Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource + Send>; AsyncAudioSource trait is defined as #[async_trait::async_trait] pub trait AsyncAudioSource: Send { async fn next_chunk(&mut self, buf: &mut [i16]) -> usize; }.
contracts.postcondition: ErasedAudioSource blanket impl auto-derived for all T: AsyncAudioSource + Send; SyncAudioSource trait and SyncSourceAdapter<T: SyncAudioSource + Send> provided for synchronous sources; any new concrete source (e.g. CpalMicrophoneSource) implementing AsyncAudioSource + Send automatically gains ErasedAudioSource.

### Goal
Replace the P8-4 placeholder body of `open_default_microphone_source` (src/api/asyncaudiosrc_adapter.rs:167-176) with real cpal device capture by adding cpal as an optional dependency behind the `cpal-input` feature, so the RFC §40 API returns `Result<Box<dyn AsyncAudioSource>, SipError>` backed by the platform default microphone, plus a feature-gated integration test.

### Purpose
The `cpal-input` feature has been declared empty (Cargo.toml:27) since P1-3, and the microphone source is the only RFC-required audio source that is not device-backed. Downstream consumers (AudioMixer via P5-2, the audio_tap example via P8-6, AI TTS source insertion) rely on opening the default microphone as an AsyncAudioSource; without this ticket the function is a stub that always returns a typed error.

### Motivation
P8-4 delivered the AsyncAudioSource adapter machinery (ErasedAudioSource/SyncAudioSource/SyncSourceAdapter) under a no-new-dependencies constraint, deferring the cpal dependency and leaving the `[::STUB::] P8-7` marker. This ticket removes that deferral: the adapter types are stable, the feature gate exists, and the remaining work is wiring cpal in and resolving the marker.

### Constraints
- cpal must be an optional dependency reachable only via `cpal-input`; default builds must not pull the cpal crate (feature-additive invariant). Cargo.toml:40 already declares `check-cfg = ['cfg(feature, values("cpal-input"))']`.
- MSRV is 1.95; pin a cpal version whose API is stable and documented. cpal 0.15/0.16/0.18 differ — v0.18 requires an explicit `stream.play()` after build and pins the sample rate/config explicitly.
- The public `open_default_microphone_source` signature must not change (C051 precondition); the returned source must implement AsyncAudioSource + Send.
- No panics on device failure — all errors map to SipError (NativeError for device/stream, AudioFormatUnsupported for non-convertible sample formats).
- CI without audio hardware must not run the device integration test by default (#[ignore]).
